svg.text: Island Colony controller with 25 male-to-female wires (uses 23)
Joystick and BUILD stay OUTSIDE the box on M-F wires. Encoder, buzzer, LED and TFT plug STRAIGHT into the breadboard.
Thick lines = M-F wires (female on the ESP32 or part). Thin dashed lines = M-M wires (breadboard to rail).
TFT header pins in row h (last 6 stay unused)
BUILD: leg 1 col 12 row c, leg 2 top − rail
ESP D4 → col 5 row f (Encoder CLK)
ESP RX2 → col 6 row f (Encoder DT)
ESP TX2 → col 7 row f (Encoder SW)
ESP D5 → col 23 row f (TFT CS)
ESP D22 → col 24 row f (TFT RESET)
ESP D21 → col 25 row f (TFT DC)
ESP D23 → col 26 row f (TFT SDI)
ESP D18 → col 27 row f (TFT SCK)
LED long leg col 17, short col 18
